mapper.sql: pos_pay_methods.id AS id, pos_pay_methods.`name` AS name, pos_pay_methods.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ', chart_accounts.account_codes, chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName
FROM pos_pay_methods LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON pos_pay_methods.chart_account_id = chart_accounts.id

WHERE pos_pay_methods.is_active = 1
AND ( pos_pay_methods.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR chart_accounts.account_codes LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR chart_accounts.account_description LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pos_pay_methods ( `name`, chart_account_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{payMethod.name}, #{payMethod.chartAccountId}, NOW(), #{payMethod.createdBy}, #{payMethod.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pos_pay_methods SET `name` = #{payMethod.name}, chart_account_id = #{payMethod.chartAccountId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{payMethod.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{payMethod.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE pos_pay_methods SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
